# KaTeX 0.16.45

`katex.min.js` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from the vault's existing
`07_misc/scripts/node_modules/katex/` installation (`dist/katex.min.js`).
Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.16.45

The publisher uses this MIT-licensed bundle only at build time, through Node.js,
to produce native MathML. It is not copied to the public website. No npm install,
client JavaScript, external stylesheet, font download, or CDN is required.
